faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Central Agricultural University Imphal (CAU) for hiring a Senior Research Fellow (SRF) on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Senior Research Fellow (SRF) with a total of 1 vacancy available for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Agriculture along with an M.Sc in Agricultural Economics, Extension, or Agri-Business Management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for CAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly via email. Eligible candidates must send their filled applications to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 10 October 2026. Make sure to apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to take place on 12 October 2026 at the designated university venue.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for applying to this temporary research position.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected Senior Research Fellow will be in Kyrdemkulai, Meghalaya with pincode 793105.

faq.question: Q10. How can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can access and download the official notification PDF by clicking the dedicated link provided in the important links section of this article.
